text: Is this too complex? like does this show i have too many faces for what is really here? [Image #24] [Image #25]
resolution: User asked whether the truck is 'too complex' / has too many faces for what's really there, showing a sliver-heavy UV atlas (349 faces per the SHAPE panel) and the textured model. Answered as analysis — no code changed. Verdict: NOT too complex — 349 faces (~700 tris) is low-poly for a game vehicle; no performance concern. Explained the face count honestly: a bare boxy truck needs ~80-120 faces; the extra ~230 come from solidify (each solidified panel adds a full inner-skin copy PLUS thin rim-wall edge bands) and detach. The busy UV atlas is exactly those rim-wall slivers, each getting a tiny island — cosmetic to the unwrap, not a perf issue. It only matters if hand-painting the texture (slivers annoying) or wanting a tidy mesh; neither affects function. Lever for leaner meshes next time: only solidify panels you see INTO (cab interior), leave can't-see-behind exterior panels single-sided. Offered to add a non-destructive 'merge coplanar faces' cleanup button to Studio to collapse slivers/flat splits and reduce the count + tidy UVs; awaiting the user's decision.
